checks: The epigraph of the convex lower roof and the finite minimum of affine parameter pieces give actual convex bodies and positive concave parameters. Taking t=x+y and u=x/t gives volume element t dt du ds. The log primitive evaluated at the moving endpoints yields mean −1/2 and c_j→exp(1/2).

The raw reciprocal decomposition is 1+b_j/(t−b_j). Its logarithmic excess is uniformly bounded, tends to H on A=H and to zero elsewhere, and contributes vanishing mass above a fixed positive t. This identifies the spatial residual, including its 2/(|F|c) factor.

The roof area density is (A/j)sqrt(2+|∇A|²/j²) in (s,u); the outward normal has the claimed signs. Side-face negative logs are uniformly integrable near the collapsing edge by translation to v=t−b_j. Facets over the base have the extra factor t. Thus the other boundary pieces contribute only ordinary trace.
The two defects obey the full vector identity by direct multiplication, including the sign −n_0 and the normalization by M=|F|/2.

The row weights are actual cell volume fractions, and the tilted row's affine mean is c_j V_ij/Z_ij. Reweighting by L_j over its marked value gives the actual uniform cell law. Positive ordinary mass in each limiting product-cell interior forces the row centroid strictly into that cell and yields an interior ball in all late bodies.

Exact independent arithmetic gives excess mass 111/200, excess first s moment 81/1000, and the displayed left mark (206/1055,25/211,25/211). The right mark follows by reflection. The resulting cap fraction (50/211)^2 is below 27/64, so the finite-body strict separation from the ordinary centroid follows from the converging traces.

The active equality set of the displayed profile is the union of the two stated intervals. For a prescribed finite union of nontrivial closed intervals, assigning the compensating upward jumps to H makes both H and H+dist(s,E) convex, and positivity yields exactly E as the defect support.

Source 9a1deed5372bf5ee §§1–5 covers the same normal bundle, the exact profiles, row scopes, and geometric restrictions. Neither this proof nor that source assumes physical stationarity of the selected marks.

dependencies.hypotheses: At each late j, K_j is a compact convex body with positive volume in dimension three. The full-volume choice in 6769574fc1bd9f8d forces density one and selects its ordinary centroid. Its right inclusion gives 27/64 for every containing closed halfspace, exactly the comparator used.

overlap.comparison: It identifies the reciprocal defect and original-volume row reweighting abstractly under finite contact hypotheses. It does not realize a prescribed tangential profile or produce the disconnected support examples.
Its unweighted vector-flux conclusion is consistent with the explicit identity here, but the new result constructs and separately evaluates both weak residuals.
